_comment: Countries the European Commission has found to ensure an adequate level of protection (GDPR Art. 45), as listed on the Commission's page on the date read. A country not listed has no adequacy decision as far as this file knows; that is a fact about the list, not a verdict about anyone. reviewBy is the day the list must be read again.
